## What does this PR do?
Adds Hugging Face checkpoint links to the Super VL and Lightning model names in README news.

## Changelog
- Link Nemotron 3.5 Super VL to its released Base BF16 checkpoint.
- Link Nemotron 3.5 Lightning to its BF16 checkpoint.
- Preserve existing documentation, verification-card, and blog links.

## GitHub Actions CI
Both supplied URLs return HTTP 200. All-file pre-commit and git diff --check passed. Fresh independent review found no issues. Runtime tests are not applicable to this two-line README-only change.

## Before your PR is Ready for review
- [x] Followed contributor guidelines.
- [x] Updated documentation and validated links.
- [ ] New runtime tests or optional-component changes (not applicable).

## Additional Information
Follow-up to #6493.

 ## 📣 News
 
-- [10/15/2026] **NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Super VL is released!** Megatron Bridge supports the 120B-A12B vision-language model with HF↔Megatron checkpoint conversion, image inference, and pretraining, SFT, and LoRA recipes, plus text-only conversion and training workflows. See the [model documentation](docs/models/nemotron/nemotron3.5-super-vl.md) and [verification card](examples/model_verification_cards/nemotron-3.5-super-vl-120b-a12b/card.yaml) for supported workflows, verified configurations, and current limitations.
+- [10/15/2026] [**NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Super VL**](https://huggingface.co/nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Super-VL-120b-a12b-base-BF16) is released! Megatron Bridge supports the 120B-A12B vision-language model with HF↔Megatron checkpoint conversion, image inference, and pretraining, SFT, and LoRA recipes, plus text-only conversion and training workflows. See the [model documentation](docs/models/nemotron/nemotron3.5-super-vl.md) and [verification card](examples/model_verification_cards/nemotron-3.5-super-vl-120b-a12b/card.yaml) for supported workflows, verified configurations, and current limitations.
 
 - [10/15/2026] [**Muse-Spark-Open-816B-A42B**](examples/models/muse_spark_open/README.md) is now supported! Megatron Bridge adds checkpoint conversion, inference, and GB200 training recipes for the 816B-total / 42B-active vision-and-audio-language MoE model: pretraining, full SFT, long-context SFT at 32K and 64K with context parallelism, LoRA, and image-text SFT and LoRA, with HybridEP MoE dispatch. See the [examples README](examples/models/muse_spark_open/README.md) and the [verification card](examples/model_verification_cards/muse-spark-open-816b-a42b/card.yaml) for details.
 
 - [08/19/2026] **Megatron Bridge 0.6.0 released!** Highlights include GLM-5.2 with cuDNN fused DSA for 128K THD-packed context-parallel training, new LLM/VLM/diffusion models, more reliable VLM data and sequence packing, improved checkpoint and LoRA workflows, unified training and conversion launchers, and refreshed performance recipes. Huge thanks to our community contributors! See the [full release notes](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/releases/tag/v0.6.0).
 
-- [08/11/2026] **NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning is released!** Read the technical blog [here](https://developer.nvidia.com/blog/nvidia-nemotron-3-5-lightning-delivers-fast-accurate-specialized-task-execution-for-long-running-agents/). See the [Nemotron 3.5 Lightning README](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/blob/main/examples/models/nemotron/nemotron_3_5_lightning/README.md) for details.
+- [08/11/2026] [**NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning**](https://huggingface.co/nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Lightning-30B-A3B-BF16) is released! Read the technical blog [here](https://developer.nvidia.com/blog/nvidia-nemotron-3-5-lightning-delivers-fast-accurate-specialized-task-execution-for-long-running-agents/). See the [Nemotron 3.5 Lightning README](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/blob/main/examples/models/nemotron/nemotron_3_5_lightning/README.md) for details.
 
 - [07/31/2026] **[K-EXAONE-2](https://huggingface.co/LGAI-EXAONE/K-EXAONE-2.0-750B-A37B) is now supported**! Day-0 support for LG AI Research's K-EXAONE-2 (750B-A37B MoE) is now available on the [k-exaone-2 branch](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/tree/k-exaone-2). Users can convert checkpoints, run inference, fine-tune with SFT or PEFT (LoRA), and use the NVFP4 inference-optimized checkpoint released alongside the model. See the branch documentation for setup instructions and examples.
